metadata.name: streetfun
metadata.description: Streetfun - The World's First Equity-Backed Memecoin Engine on Solana

accounts.name: target_equity_mint
docs: SPL or Token-2022 mint of the target equity (e.g. OpenAI, SpaceX, Kalshi)

accounts.name: caller
docs: Permissionless finalizer. This wallet pays pool and position rent.

accounts.name: target_equity_mint
docs: Tessera T-Token on mainnet, or an explicitly-labelled test collateral mint on Devnet.

accounts.name: equity_damm_v2_pool
docs: Existing DAMM v2 quote/target-equity pair. The program verifies its token pair and reserves.

accounts.name: caller_quote_account
docs: Temporary ATAs receive the pool's assets before DAMM v2 initializes its first position.

accounts.name: damm_v2_pool
docs: The DAMM v2 customizable-pool PDA and its first LP position are created in this instruction.

accounts.name: position_nft_mint
docs: A fresh keypair signer, minted as the first DAMM v2 position NFT for the curve PDA.

accounts.name: target_equity_mint
docs: SPL Token or Token-2022 mint of the target equity (e.g. OpenAI, SpaceX, Kalshi)

accounts.name: quote_mint
docs: Quote token mint (e.g. USDC)

accounts.name: meme_mint
docs: DBC creates and fixes the SPL mint before this instruction runs.

accounts.name: equity_damm_v2_pool
docs: The live USDC/collateral DAMM v2 pool selected during launch preparation.

accounts.name: partner_quote_account
docs: Partner migration fees are claimed to this protocol PDA ATA by the
creator-authorized settlement instruction; it is not a user wallet.

accounts.name: caller
docs: The creator may settle immediately; after the fallback delay settlement is permissionless.

accounts.name: migrated_dbc_damm_pool
docs: The canonical DAMM v2 pool created by DBC migration for this launch.

accounts.name: migrated_dbc_damm_config
docs: The DAMM v2 config used by DBC's manual or keeper migration.

accounts.name: migrated_dbc_damm_token_a_vault
docs: Both live vaults must be the vault addresses recorded in the migrated pool.

accounts.name: equity_damm_v2_pool
docs: The live USDC/selected collateral DAMM v2 market used for the equity leg.

errors.name: ZeroAmount
errors.msg: Amount must be greater than zero.

errors.name: CurveAlreadyGraduated
errors.msg: Bonding curve has already graduated. Bonding curve trades are closed.

errors.name: CurveNotGraduated
errors.msg: Bonding curve has not graduated yet. Burn and redeem is not accessible.

errors.name: GraduationThresholdReached
errors.msg: Graduation threshold reached. Curve must be graduated.

errors.name: GraduationThresholdNotReached
errors.msg: Graduation threshold has not been reached yet.

errors.name: SlippageExceeded
errors.msg: Slippage tolerance exceeded.

errors.name: InsufficientLiquidity
errors.msg: Insufficient token liquidity available in curve vault.

errors.name: InsufficientQuoteReserves
errors.msg: Insufficient quote reserves in curve vault.

errors.name: InvalidEquityMint
errors.msg: Target equity mint does not match the curve target equity.

errors.name: MathOverflow
errors.msg: Arithmetic overflow or underflow occurred.

errors.name: CalculationError
errors.msg: Calculation error occurred in bonding curve engine.

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: Signer is not authorized to execute this instruction.

errors.name: CurveVaultMismatch
errors.msg: Curve vault account does not match expected PDA.

errors.name: TreasuryVaultMismatch
errors.msg: Treasury vault account does not match expected PDA.

errors.name: InvalidFeeBps
errors.msg: Fee basis points exceed maximum allowed limit.

errors.name: SettlementUnavailable
errors.msg: Verified asset purchase and liquidity settlement are unavailable.

errors.name: InvalidDammV2Pool
errors.msg: The DAMM v2 pool, token pair, or pool accounts do not match the requested settlement.

errors.name: SettlementAmountsMismatch
errors.msg: Settlement token balances do not match the required 50/50 allocation.

errors.name: InvalidTokenProgram
errors.msg: Invalid token program provided for target equity mint.

errors.name: SupplyInvariantViolation
errors.msg: Curve supply must match the fixed launch supply and live meme mint supply.

errors.name: SettlementFallbackNotReady
errors.msg: Permissionless settlement opens 24 hours after Meteora records the curve completion.

fields.name: min_equity_tokens_out
docs: Minimum spendable equity tokens the redeemer must receive after any Token-2022 fee.

types.name: DbcLaunchAccount
docs: StreetFun's collateral and settlement registry for a Meteora DBC launch.
DBC owns the curve and token vaults; StreetFun stores only the backing asset
and the settlement proof required before collateral redemption is enabled.

fields.name: meteora_damm_v2_pool
docs: Selected collateral market before graduation; migrated DBC pool afterward.

fields.name: min_equity_tokens_expected
docs: Minimum net target-equity units the DAMM v2 swap must deliver.

fields.name: pool_liquidity
docs: DAMM v2 BothToken pool inputs; all other pool settings are fixed below.

fields.name: min_equity_tokens_expected
docs: Minimum spendable equity tokens the DAMM v2 swap must deliver.

types.name: SettlementPolicy
docs: Administrator-approved market and minimum net exchange rate. Rates expire
independently of pool spot prices, which a settlement caller can manipulate.

fields.name: minimum_output_numerator
docs: Minimum spendable equity atoms / input quote atoms, after all fees.
